facts.activity_file: insulating, guarding and signing hot surfaces

assets.label: package boilers and deaerator
assets.service: process steam generation and feedwater deaeration

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.title: uncontrolled movement of B-8201 during cleaning and preparation

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control HOT_SURFACE_GUARDING: the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces had degraded below its design intent, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces on B-8201 and PSV-8201 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on B-8201 and PSV-8201 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in protecting people from hot surfaces, specifically insulating, guarding and signing hot surfaces. B-8201 (package boilers and deaerator) is in service for process steam generation and feedwater deaeration. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 28 April 2005 an incident occurred on B-8201 and PSV-8201 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during cleaning and preparation, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
